title: Fastmoney Ant shares a high energy visual for new single "Say Datt"
htmlContent:
Fastmoney Ant delivers a high energy new single “Say Datt,” featuring fellow Chicago rapper Lil Zay Osama. As soon as you hit play you hear the driving percussion, and knocking bass set the ultimate tone for the incredible emceeing that takes place.

Their presence is impossible to deny as you get as they let their lyrics fly all over this beat, as each bar lands with masterful precision to keep things clicking in a major way on this supreme release. The single "Say Datt" is the music you can play for anyone and they become a fan. It’s the perfect testament to their talent, but also a shining example of how fun discovering new music can be, with a stand out sound that brings fresh life to the culture, to make you keep coming back for more.
